newsitem.title: USA: Pinnacle Micro restates Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: Pinnacle Micro restates Q3 results.

text.p: Pinnacle Micro Inc said that after consulting with the Securities and Exchange Commission, it is restating its 1996 third quarter results to account for a new accounting method for non-cash interest expenses.
As a result, the company said its third quarter loss has been increased to $9,093,000 or $1.15 per share. Pinnacle had previously reported a third quarter loss of $7,807,000 or $0.98 per share.
A report on Form 10-Q/A will be filed with the SEC today, Pinnacle said.
Pinnacle said operating income and cash are not affected by this restatement.
